item.text: {"chapter_reviews":[{"attribution_risk":"medium","bias_review":{"allegations_vs_findings":"Adequately distinguished in the strongest adverse records: USTR consultations are identified as a disputing government's allegations rather than a merits ruling (WEB-5B-010), and procurement risk flags are not treated as bribery, corruption findings, or loss findings (WEB-5B-011). This discipline is weaker for broad claims about weak project appraisal, uncorrected health deterioration, and Pemex-centered strategy, which lack event-level confirmation of executive decisions or responses.","closed_system_silence":"Material risk. Government administrative records document acts and totals, but incomplete/late Compranet publication can conceal procurement problems (WEB-5B-011), while the unextracted ASF contract audits leave confirmed irregularities, remedies, and losses unknown.","duplicate_reporting":"No duplicated stable IDs or recreated chapter-specific copies are apparent. Several claims rest on the same underlying institutional family: IMF supports WEB-5B-001, WEB-5B-003, and WEB-5B-004; CONEVAL/INEGI underlies WEB-5B-006 and WEB-5B-007 and is also synthesized by WEB-5B-008 and WEB-5B-015; OECD supports WEB-5B-012 and WEB-5B-016. These should not be treated as independent corroboration of the same outcome.","favorable_and_adverse_search":"Both favorable and adverse material were sought and retained: wage, labor-income, employment, fiscal-stability, and FDI material is balanced against subsidy targeting, buffers, health access, procurement, and energy-rule concerns. The balance remains incomplete because promised program evaluations, audit records, and causal wage/transfer evidence were not inspected.","missing_source_type":"Independent primary audit, program-evaluation, and causal microdata sources are missing for the main bias risks: procurement/project integrity, transfer and wage incidence, and whether identified weaknesses were corrected. A source on actual presidential delegation or finance-minister performance is also missing for 5B.2.","official_claim_independence":"Official administrative claims are partly checked by IMF, OECD, CONEVAL, World Bank, IMCO, and USTR. However, the FDI, formal-employment, and minimum-wage records remain government-primary/access-limited (WEB-5B-005, WEB-5B-009, WEB-5B-013); the World Bank poverty-policy linkage is a homepage-level retrospective locator and cannot independently resolve causation (WEB-5B-015).","open_system_complaint_volume":"The adverse account does not rely on complaint volume. USTR is an interested foreign-government complainant, and IMCO measures procurement-risk indicators rather than adjudicated misconduct; neither should be read as a count of proved wrongdoing (WEB-5B-010, WEB-5B-011).","population_exposure_authority_baseline_shocks":"Strongly addressed for macro and welfare interpretation: reopening, U.S. demand, remittances, global inflation, oil prices, autonomous monetary policy, inherited institutions, low tax capacity, regional/gender disparities, and pre-existing fiscal-buffer conditions are stated and often linked to evidence (WEB-5B-001, WEB-5B-002, WEB-5B-003, WEB-5B-004, WEB-5B-006, WEB-5B-007, WEB-5B-016, WEB-5B-018). their precise supporting locators should be recovered or independently corroborated.","WEB-5B-015 uses a country-overview homepage as a locator and should not carry causal weight until a precise World Bank document or section is recovered.","WEB-5B-012 bundles multiple materially distinct OECD claims and should be split before downstream use; this is deterministic cleanup, not a reason by itself to continue research.","Evidence of the competence and actual delegation of economic professionals is thin; WEB-5B-014 establishes the Banxico appointment and biography, not finance-minister competence or presidential delegation.","No extracted ASF contract-level audit, program-level evaluation, or causal microdata resolves whether procurement/project risks yielded confirmed harms, whether programs reached intended groups, or whether the administration corrected identified weaknesses."]},"chapter_id":"5B","defensible_evidence_estimate":17,"independent_source_family_estimate":12,"missing_themes":["5B.2: evidence on finance-minister qualifications, professional autonomy, and actual presidential delegation beyond the Banxico nomination.","5B.5: contract-level audit findings, final resolutions, remedies, and any confirmed procurement loss or misconduct; separate energy-policy allegations from adjudicated findings.","5B.6: project-level cost-benefit appraisal, delivery quality, and productivity effects for flagship infrastructure and social-investment choices.","5B.7: dated evidence of whether the administration accepted, rejected, or corrected procurement, health-access, fuel-subsidy, Pemex, and appraisal warnings during 2022.","5B.8: ENIGH/program-level incidence and causal evidence separating minimum-wage, transfer, reopening, remittance, and labor-demand effects across deciles, regions, gender, and informality."],"substantive_issues":["WEB-5B-015 is a homepage-level source with a non-precise locator and is excluded from the defensible estimate until a precise underlying locator is recovered.","Several records are access-limited or indexed-extraction based rather than precisely opened (WEB-5B-005, WEB-5B-009, WEB-5B-013);
